title: mut.channel_gatan_robillard
mutation_directive: Lumen Prize winner — Gaëtan Robillard (2023 · BCS Futures) — 'Critical Climate Machine'. VISUAL SIGNATURE: Climate-misinformation text streams reified as a kinetic data sculpture — words and statistics flowing through transparent geometric volumes, exposing manipulation by making it physical. TECHNICAL HOOKS: Particle text glyphs flow along a vector field; nodes labeled 'truth' / 'distortion' bend the field, splitting streams into clean and turbulent branches — geometry: glyph sprites along splines; palette: instrument-panel teal on near-black. REF: https://lumenprize.org/2023-winners
